name: @quillarium/desktop
description: Quillarium desktop writing workspace for long-form fiction.
author: Quillarium Contributors

scripts.build: tsc -b && pnpm --filter @quillarium/checks copy:prompts && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json
scripts.package: pnpm -w build && pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.package:dir: pnpm -w build && pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --dir --publish never
scripts.package:win: pnpm -w build && pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win --publish never
scripts.package:mac: pnpm -w build && pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac --publish never
